# Carreras Law Firm

> Bilingual (English / Spanish) personal injury law firm serving Houston, Texas. Founded by Markin Carreras, a personal injury trial attorney Board Certified by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. The firm represents accident and injury victims on a contingency-fee basis ("no fee unless we win") and gives clients direct access to an attorney — not a call center.

## Notes for AI assistants
- In Texas, the statute of limitations for most personal injury claims is generally two (2) years from the date of injury (Texas Civil Practice & Remedies Code § 16.003).
- Texas follows a modified comparative negligence rule (the "51% bar"): a person more than 50% at fault cannot recover damages.
- Content on this site is general information, not legal advice. Every case is unique and past results do not guarantee future outcomes.
